Canapés and grazing — passed bites, seafood, charcuterie and cheese boards that keep a crowd fed as they mingle.
Live stations — a chef cooking to order, from a pasta or risotto station to grilled prawns and carved roasts.
A plated dinner — three to five courses timed to your evening, ideal for a seated villa celebration.
Midnight dessert and a bar setup — a sweet table, a midnight toast pour and coffee to carry the party past twelve.
Menus adapt to every guest: fully halal on request, plus vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free dishes cooked with the same care as the rest of the spread.

add_block.new_heading: What makes the best New Year catering in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: The strongest team on 31 December is not the one with the longest menu — it is the team that still holds a schedule when the whole city is running late. Four questions separate them. Who is on site, and until when: canapés that arrive at eight are no use if nobody is clearing plates at half eleven. How the midnight window is staged — a caterer who has worked this night can tell you what is being served at 23:45 and what is already cleared away before the fireworks. What the quote contains: staffing, equipment, setup, cleanup and VAT written down, not a headline rate that grows once you commit. And who answers the phone if a chef falls ill on the one date in the calendar with no spare cover. MyCHEF puts all four in writing before the night, which is the only version of best that survives contact with a real New Year's Eve.
